name: File Atlas
releaseNotes: Release-signed ZIP support: create ZIP archives, extract ZIP files safely with path-traversal protection, and open ZIP files from Android Files or Downloads.
description: File Atlas is a phone file manager for browsing local storage with folders, categories, search, sorting, file details, open/share, rename, delete, path copying, and safe ZIP creation/extraction. Android can offer File Atlas when a ZIP is opened from Files or Downloads.
